# Hemant Chaurasia — full profile for language models

This file matches the public portfolio. It does not add employers, metrics, or expertise that the site does not claim.

## Identity

Hemant Chaurasia is a Computer Science Engineering graduate from Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti Language University, Lucknow (B.Tech, 2021–2025, SGPA 7.0 stated on his resume). He also studied at Colvin Taluqdars College (2019–2021, 84%) and Bal Vidya Mandir Senior Secondary School (2016–2018, 74%).

He lives in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, and is open to work. He describes himself as a technology enthusiast, an aspiring software professional, a builder, a problem solver, and a digital community operator. He is not limited to one job title.

## Professional experience

Maaricha — Web Development Intern — April 2024 to September 2024 — Hazratganj, Lucknow.

He maintained website content and database information, investigated functionality issues, worked with WordPress and Wix, troubleshot user-facing bugs, and collaborated with the team. One platform was Ivani Diamonds, a Wix website. This was maintenance of an existing site, not a product he founded.

## Community experience

Storm Esports — he managed a Discord server of about 15,000 members.

Responsibilities: server management; Tier 2 and Tier 3 BGMI scrims; small BGMI tournaments; registrations and registration automation; channels, roles, permissions, and settings; Discord bots and API integrations; community coordination and member support.

No engagement rates or attendance figures are published, because they were not provided.

## Projects

1. Simple Web Server — Golang. A basic HTTP server for learning requests, responses, routes, and server behaviour. https://github.com/hemantchaurasia2002/simple_web_server
2. Slack Age Bot — Golang. Calculates age from a date of birth inside Slack, with validation. https://github.com/hemantchaurasia2002/slack_age_bot
3. Email Checker Tool — Golang. Format checks plus mail-server connectivity and response handling. https://github.com/hemantchaurasia2002/email_checker_tool
4. Online Resume Builder — HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, made during B.Tech summer training. No public repository was provided.
5. Ivani Diamonds — Wix maintenance during the Maaricha internship. No public repository was provided.

Case studies: /work/simple-web-server /work/slack-age-bot /work/email-checker-tool /work/online-resume-builder /work/ivani-diamonds
